_comment: C-first downward-magic grave caller recipe for B63, based on the two preserved setup misses. Seed 80641327 and the Wizard creation/options remain fixed to isolate route correction. The C map showed the hero starts on a stair: two west steps leave that stair/door tile for the interior ROOM square, which engrave.c:make_grave accepts. Then wish a grave and a wand of digging, select the observed wand inventory letter n, and aim down to reach dig.c:zap_dig -> dighole(FALSE, TRUE, NULL) -> dig_up_grave. This recipe is frozen before its C run and any JS comparison.
